name: Crab Dip
description: A rich and creamy crab dip made with cream cheese, crab meat, and green onions, served with crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Blend all ingredients together, including the juice from the crab meat, until smooth.
Serve with crackers.

keywords: crab dip, seafood dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Crab & Cheese Platter
_similar.description: A layered seafood appetizer featuring a creamy cheese base topped with cocktail sauce and crab meat.
recipeIngredient: 2 large packages (8 oz each) cream cheese

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together the cream cheese, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, mayonnaise and onion flakes in a blender, or beat with an electric mixer, until smooth and creamy.
Spread cheese mixture evenly over the surface of a large round platter, leaving room around the outside for a row of crackers.
Press the centre of the cheese mixture down lightly to make a slightly raised border, about ½ to 1 in wide, around the outer edge.
Spread seafood cocktail sauce over the cheese layer within this border, leaving an outside rim of the cheese layer showing.
Drain the crab meat and spread it over the sauce layer, again leaving a border of seafood sauce showing.
Serve with crackers or vegetables.

_similar.keywords: crab dip, layered platter, seafood appetizer

_similar.name: Shrimp Spread
_similar.description: A savory shrimp and cheddar cheese spread served with crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together in a medium bowl.
Mash the shrimp with a fork until well blended.
Refrigerate before serving with crackers.

_similar.keywords: shrimp spread, seafood dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Surprise Spread
_similar.description: A layered seafood dip with shrimp, cocktail sauce, and cheese.
recipeIngredient: 3 (4 oz) cans small shrimp, rinsed and drained
Tortilla chips or assorted crackers for serving

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the cream cheese, sour cream, and mayonnaise together until smooth.
Spread this mixture in the bottom of a deep pie plate, pizza pan, or shallow baking dish.
Scatter the shrimp over the top.
Cover with the seafood cocktail sauce.
Add layers of mozzarella cheese, green pepper, and green onions.
Top with diced tomatoes if desired.
Chill until ready to serve with tortilla chips or crackers.

_similar.keywords: layered shrimp dip, seafood spread, party dip

_similar.name: Cheese Dip in a Bread Bowl
_similar.description: A warm cheese and ham dip served in a hollowed-out bread loaf.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the bread loaf and hollow out most of the soft bread inside.
Mix together the cream cheese, sour cream, ham, green pepper, green onion, cheddar cheese, Tabasco sauce, and Worcestershire sauce.
Fill the hollowed bread loaf with the cheese mixture and replace the lid.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Serve hot with the reserved bread chunks and fresh veggies for dipping.

_similar.keywords: bread bowl dip, ham and cheese dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Cheese Ball
_similar.description: A classic cheese ball made with grated cheese, Cheez Whiz, and deviled ham, perfect for a quick appetizer.
recipeIngredient: Chopped pecans or parsley flakes for coating

recipeInstructions.text: Beat all ingredients in a mixer until creamed.
Form into 2 balls and wrap in Saran Wrap.
Refrigerate until firm.
Roll into chopped pecans or parsley flakes to coat.

_similar.keywords: cheese ball, party appetizer, easy snack
